sourcePrd: Enable Form 16 and Tax Sheets on Alumni Portal

environment.buildBehavior: App cold-start opens Alumni user landing page directly (no OTP/login)

testcases.TestCaseName: Compensation app tile visible on Alumni landing page when Payroll module enabled
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Happy path: alumni debug build lands on landing page; Compensation tile appears when admin enabled Payroll module.
testcases.AdminSetup: Tenant Provision Settings > Platform > Enable Alumni Portal; add Payroll module; Save
testcases.Precondition: Alumni debug build installed; Payroll module enabled; network available; Alumni Access enabled for test employee
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Compensation app tile is visible on Alumni Portal landing page when Payroll module is enabled

testcases.TestCaseName: Tapping Compensation tile opens Compensation app view
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Navigation: tap Compensation tile from landing page and verify Compensation shell loads with FY dropdown.
testcases.AdminSetup: Payroll module enabled; at least one released payslip for default FY
testcases.Precondition: Alumni debug build on landing page; Compensation tile visible
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Tapping Compensation tile navigates to Compensation app view with FY dropdown at top-left

testcases.TestCaseName: Financial Year dropdown defaults to most recent applicable FY
testcases.TestCaseDescription: FY dropdown shows most recent applicable financial year on Compensation app launch.
testcases.AdminSetup: Form 16 and Tax Sheet released for FY 2025-26; payslips released for FY 2026-27 and FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page after opening from landing page
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: FY dropdown defaults to the most recent applicable financial year on Compensation app launch

testcases.TestCaseName: Payslips tab is visible on Compensation page
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Payslips tab is displayed on Compensation app.
testcases.AdminSetup: Payroll module enabled; released payslips exist for default FY
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Payslips tab is displayed on Compensation app alongside other document tabs

testcases.TestCaseName: Tax Sheets tab is visible when Tax Sheet exists for selected FY
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Tax Sheets tab shown when Tax Sheet document exists for selected FY.
testcases.AdminSetup: Tax Sheet uploaded and released in Payroll for FY 2026-27
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page with FY 2026-27 selected
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Tax Sheets tab is shown when a Tax Sheet document exists for the selected financial year

testcases.TestCaseName: Form 16A and Form 16B cards visible when Form 16 uploaded and released for selected FY
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Form 16A and Form 16B cards shown when Part A and Part B uploaded and released.
testcases.AdminSetup: Form 16 Part A and Part B uploaded and released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page with FY 2025-26 selected
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Form 16A and Form 16B cards are shown when Form 16 (Part A + Part B) is uploaded and released for the selected FY

testcases.TestCaseName: Payslips tab displays monthly payslip list for selected FY
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Monthly payslip list shows all released payslips for selected FY.
testcases.AdminSetup: At least 3 monthly payslips released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page; FY 2025-26 selected
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Monthly payslip list displays all released payslips for the selected financial year

testcases.TestCaseName: Off-Cycle Payslips collapsible section visible when off-cycle data exists
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Off-Cycle Payslips section shown and expandable when off-cycle payslips exist.
testcases.AdminSetup: At least one off-cycle payslip released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Payslips tab with FY 2025-26 selected
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Off-Cycle Payslips section is shown and expandable when off-cycle payslips exist for selected FY

testcases.TestCaseName: Download payslip from Payslips tab
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Alumni downloads released payslip PDF from Payslips tab.
testcases.AdminSetup: Released payslip PDF exists for a month in FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Payslips tab; payslip list loaded
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Alumni can download a released payslip PDF from the Payslips tab

testcases.TestCaseName: Download Form 16 PDF for selected FY
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Core tax-filing use case: download Form 16 Part A+B for selected FY.
testcases.AdminSetup: Form 16 Part A and Part B uploaded and released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page; FY 2025-26 selected
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Alumni downloads Form 16 PDF (Part A + Part B) for selected FY in under 30 seconds (self-service)

testcases.TestCaseName: Download Tax Sheet PDF for selected FY
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Loan-application use case: download Tax Sheet for selected FY.
testcases.AdminSetup: Tax Sheet uploaded and released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page; FY 2025-26 selected
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Alumni downloads Tax Sheet PDF for selected FY without HR dependency

testcases.TestCaseName: Tax Sheet PDF viewer renders document for selected FY
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Tax Sheet displayed in read-only PDF viewer.
testcases.AdminSetup: Tax Sheet PDF released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Tax Sheets tab with FY 2025-26 selected
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Tax Sheet document is displayed in read-only PDF viewer for the selected financial year

testcases.TestCaseName: Form 16 PDF viewer renders Part A and Part B for selected FY
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Form 16 viewer displays Part A+B; title reflects FY.
testcases.AdminSetup: Form 16 Part A and Part B released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Form 16 tab with FY 2025-26 selected
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Form 16 PDF viewer displays Part A and Part B for the selected financial year; title updates per FY selection

testcases.TestCaseName: Changing FY dropdown updates payslips list content
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Payslips list refreshes when FY changed.
testcases.AdminSetup: Released payslips for FY 2026-27 and FY 2025-26 with different month counts
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Payslips tab
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Payslips list refreshes to show payslips for the newly selected financial year

testcases.TestCaseName: Changing FY dropdown updates Tax Sheet document
testcases.TestCaseDescription: PRD edge rule: Tax Sheet tab hidden when no document for selected FY.
testcases.AdminSetup: Tax Sheet released for FY 2025-26 only; not available for FY 2024-25
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Tax Sheets tab with FY 2025-26
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Tax Sheet content or tab visibility updates correctly when financial year is changed

testcases.TestCaseName: Compensation page is read-only with no edit or declaration controls
testcases.TestCaseDescription: No edit buttons, declarations, or input fields on any tab.
testcases.AdminSetup: Payroll module enabled; all three tabs have data for default FY
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page; each tab visited sequentially
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Compensation app is read-only; no edit buttons declarations or input fields on any tab

testcases.TestCaseName: Compensation tile hidden when Payroll module disabled via web admin
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Web admin POST disables is_payroll on alumni portal settings; mobile pull-to-refresh verifies Compensation tile hidden; web restores is_payroll=1.
testcases.AdminSetup: Alumni Portal enabled; Payroll module enabled initially; Chrome available for web admin session
testcases.Precondition: Alumni debug build on landing page; admin credentials for mobile8 QA tenant
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Compensation app tile is not shown on Alumni landing page when Payroll module is not enabled

testcases.TestCaseName: Empty state when no payslips released for selected FY
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Payslips empty state per PRD exact copy.
testcases.AdminSetup: Payroll enabled; zero payslips released for FY 2024-25
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page
testcases.ExpectedEmptyStateMessage: No payslips are available for the selected Financial Year.
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Payslips tab shows empty state: No payslips are available for the selected Financial Year.

testcases.TestCaseName: Tax Sheets tab hidden when no Tax Sheet for selected FY
testcases.TestCaseDescription: PRD rule: Tax Sheets tab not shown when no document for FY.
testcases.AdminSetup: Tax Sheet NOT uploaded for FY 2024-25
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Tax Sheets tab is not shown when no Tax Sheet exists for the selected financial year

testcases.TestCaseName: Form 16 tab hidden when Form 16 not uploaded or released
testcases.TestCaseDescription: PRD rule: Form 16 tab not shown when not uploaded/released.
testcases.AdminSetup: Form 16 NOT uploaded/released for FY 2024-25
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Form 16 tab is not shown when Form 16 is not uploaded or released for the selected FY

testcases.TestCaseName: Network unavailable blocks Form 16 download with error feedback
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Offline Form 16 download shows error without crash.
testcases.AdminSetup: Form 16 released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Form 16 tab; PDF viewer loaded; network toggled via adb
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Form 16 download fails gracefully when offline; user sees controlled error feedback without app crash

testcases.TestCaseName: Network unavailable blocks Tax Sheet download with error feedback
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Offline Tax Sheet download shows error without crash.
testcases.AdminSetup: Tax Sheet released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Tax Sheets tab; PDF viewer loaded
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Tax Sheet download handles offline state with clear error messaging and no crash

testcases.TestCaseName: Network unavailable blocks payslip download with error feedback
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Offline payslip download fails; succeeds on retry when online.
testcases.AdminSetup: Released payslip exists for current FY
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Payslips tab with payslip list visible
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Payslip download shows offline error when network unavailable; succeeds on retry when online

testcases.TestCaseName: Session expired on Compensation page redirects to login
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Expired session blocks Compensation access.
testcases.AdminSetup: Valid alumni session initially
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page; session expiry simulated
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Expired session blocks Compensation access and routes user to authentication flow

testcases.TestCaseName: Compensation tile removed after admin disables Payroll module
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Web admin POST disables is_payroll; mobile relaunch and pull-to-refresh verify Compensation tile removed; web restores is_payroll=1.
testcases.AdminSetup: Alumni Portal enabled; Payroll module enabled initially; Chrome available for web admin session
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on landing page with Compensation tile visible; admin credentials for mobile8 QA tenant
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Removing Payroll module from admin settings hides Compensation tile after app relaunch/config sync

testcases.TestCaseName: Select oldest available FY in dropdown boundary test
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Oldest FY selectable; content loads per document rules.
testcases.AdminSetup: Payroll data spans FY 2024-25 through 2026-27 with documents released per FY rules
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Oldest available FY can be selected and content loads per document availability rules for that year

testcases.TestCaseName: Select newest FY in dropdown boundary test
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Newest FY selection loads correct tabs and content.
testcases.AdminSetup: Current FY 2026-27 as newest with documents released
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Newest financial year selection loads correct document tabs and content

testcases.TestCaseName: FY with payslips only shows Payslips tab and hides Tax Sheet and Form 16 tabs
testcases.TestCaseDescription: not possible on debug build for current QA tenant — FY 2024-25 doesn't have Tax Sheets/Form 16 data; payslips-only FY scenario available.
testcases.AdminSetup: FY 2024-25: payslips released; no Tax Sheet; no Form 16 uploaded
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Only tabs with available documents are shown; payslips-only FY hides Tax Sheets and Form 16 tabs

testcases.TestCaseName: FY with all document types shows all three tabs
testcases.TestCaseDescription: All three tabs visible when all documents exist for FY.
testcases.AdminSetup: FY 2025-26: payslips Tax Sheet and Form 16 all released
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page with FY 2025-26
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: All three tabs (Payslips Tax Sheets Form 16) are visible when documents exist for selected FY

testcases.TestCaseName: Off-Cycle Payslips section collapsed by default
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Off-cycle section collapsed on initial Payslips tab load.
testcases.AdminSetup: Off-cycle payslips exist for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Payslips tab with FY 2025-26 selected
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Off-Cycle Payslips section is collapsed by default on initial Payslips tab load

testcases.TestCaseName: Expand Off-Cycle Payslips section reveals off-cycle rows
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Expanding off-cycle section shows off-cycle payslip entries.
testcases.AdminSetup: At least one off-cycle payslip released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Payslips tab with FY 2025-26 selected; off-cycle section collapsed
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Expanding Off-Cycle section reveals off-cycle payslip entries for selected FY

testcases.TestCaseName: Form 16 document title updates when FY selection changes
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Form 16 title changes per FY per PRD design note.
testcases.AdminSetup: Form 16 released for FY 2025-26 and FY 2024-25
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Form 16 tab
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Form 16 document name/title changes based on selected financial year per design spec

testcases.TestCaseName: Rapid FY dropdown change does not crash or show stale data
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Rapid FY switching handled without crash or stale list.
testcases.AdminSetup: Multiple FYs with payslip data available
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Payslips tab
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Rapid FY switching is handled without crash or permanently stale list content

testcases.TestCaseName: App backgrounding during Form 16 PDF load resumes correctly
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Background during PDF load does not crash; recovers on resume.
testcases.AdminSetup: Form 16 released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Form 16 tab; PDF loading in progress
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Backgrounding during Form 16 PDF load does not crash app; viewer recovers on resume

testcases.TestCaseName: Network switch WiFi to mobile data during Tax Sheet download
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Network path change during download handled without crash.
testcases.AdminSetup: Tax Sheet released for FY 2025-26; device on WiFi
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Tax Sheets tab; download initiated
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Network path change during Tax Sheet download is handled without application termination

testcases.TestCaseName: Screen rotation on Compensation page preserves tab and FY state
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Rotation does not reset FY or active tab.
testcases.AdminSetup: Form 16 released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Compensation page with Form 16 tab selected; auto-rotate enabled; FY 2025-26 selected
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Screen rotation does not reset FY selection or active tab on Compensation page

testcases.TestCaseName: Process kill and relaunch restores Compensation tile on landing page
testcases.TestCaseDescription: After force-stop, Compensation tile and navigation still work.
testcases.AdminSetup: Payroll module enabled
testcases.Precondition: Alumni saw Compensation tile; session still valid on relaunch
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: After process death and relaunch Compensation tile and navigation remain functional when session persists

testcases.TestCaseName: Airplane mode blocks document download then succeeds on retry
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Offline blocks download; online retry succeeds.
testcases.AdminSetup: Form 16 released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni on Form 16 tab; viewer loaded
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Offline blocks download with clear feedback; online retry succeeds without requiring app reinstall

testcases.TestCaseName: Android back from Form 16 PDF viewer returns to Compensation tabs
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Device back returns to tab view without losing session.
testcases.AdminSetup: Form 16 released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni viewing Form 16 in PDF viewer for FY 2025-26
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Pressing device back from Form 16 viewer returns to Compensation tab view without losing session

testcases.TestCaseName: Low-memory kill during payslip list scroll recovers on relaunch
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Process death during scroll recovers cleanly on relaunch.
testcases.AdminSetup: Multiple payslips released for FY 2025-26
testcases.Precondition: Alumni scrolling payslips list
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Process death during payslip list interaction recovers cleanly on relaunch
